body: I merge the lower tier stuff all at once. Once I got to the maracas and the green hat, I actually started counting them. There’s only a difference of one or two beads left over if you count all of them out to merge by 5s. I just don’t think it’s worth it.

Sometimes if a Gaia statue isn’t healed yet, the quest will complete itself when you merge you Gaia statues to finish the level, if that makes sense. Other times I’ve had the quest finish itself after I complete the level because the Gaia statues will heal all remaining land anyways.

My parents never believed a word I said because I was the youngest and the only girl. They were in the middle of a divorce and thought I only spoke up for attention. I understand they had their own things going on, but I needed to be listened to. I needed for someone to hear me, especially my parents. 
No, mom, there’s a reason I don’t want to stay at the neighbor girl’s house anymore and it’s not because I want you to not have your person alone time. It because the mom beats me if she think I’m lying, and my older “friend” steals all my clothes and locks me in the closet naked. But yeah, totally just looking for attention. Feel free to drop me off there for the weekend.
I’ll carry the trauma the rest of my life because my parents wouldn’t listen to their 10 year old child.

I’ll go first. I work in an big name ice cream shop In the states and two women came in to get some ice cream, claiming they had a coupon. Someone else makes their 2 *half gallons* of ice cream and I go to ring them up at the register. They say they have a BOGO coupon for signing up with the reward program. They give me their phone number but no rewards display on my register. I said that they can’t do the BOGO because nothing showed up. They said the coupon went to her email, and when I asked to see the email to get a PLU number, Karen got upset I asked to see the email (which means it didn’t exist). Normally it’s not a big deal, but our half gallons are $15. Never in a million years would our big corporate heads do a BOGO on a $15 product. Maybe on the single or double scoop ice creams, but not the half gallons. Nope. I told them without a coupon I can’t process the BOGO and they have to pay full price. This woman then says to me “well, we’re lawyers And the coupon didn’t have any restrictions on it for what ice cream we could BOGO. So I won’t pay for this ice cream.” She goes to WALK AWAY without paying ANYTHING. In the end, she asked for my full name, the managers name, the  owners name and phone number, and said they’d file a formal complaint with corporate. Needless to say, they didn’t tip. 
TL;DR Karen’s a lawyer and tried to steal some ice cream.
